name: Table of Contents
description: Índice de contenidos automático: el bloque Verso "TableOfContents" escanea los H2/H3 de la página y genera un índice anidado con anclas, scroll suave y resaltado de la sección activa.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Run the plugin's own compiled interface in the browser: its Verso block (in the editor and on public pages). Without it the host does not serve these bundles and that interface does not load.
